{{Quote|All of the village's children knew her as the storyteller. On hot summer evenings, we'd gather under the takka trees to hear her tell tales of grand adventures and brave heroes.|Ana Tathis, on Lady Caryn|<ref name="RPG">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>}}
A '''village''' existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The [[Youngling/Legends|children]] of the settlement, including the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ana Tathis]], gathered under the nearby [[takka tree]]s on [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] [[Summer/Legends|summer]] [[Local day/Legends|evenings]] in order to listen to tales told by the [[Gender/Legends|woman]] known as [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Caryn (Jedi)|Caryn]].<ref name="RPG" />
